note: Issue 368, governor sheet N8. Placeholder prose in the default tone; the tone pass comes later. Only a governor who thinks well of the PC warns him; the Diplomat's a_duke_backs_the_rebels is the other voice.

body.text: {param:duke}'s men are in {param:rebel}. They came with money and they came with muskets, and nobody there pretended to be surprised.
I write from {param:town} because we are nearer to it than you are, and because a town with a duke behind it is not the same trouble as a town with a grievance.
I do not know what they will do with him. I know what he will do with them, given time.

options.text: and have read it with care
and would rather not have needed it

options.label: see to your defences
options.text: See to your walls. If the duke is next door, he is next door to you.

options.label: give your own people no cause
options.text: Give your own people no reason to look over the fence. See that they want for nothing.
